theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_ie_shifted_ball_integral_sub_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (x w : Euclid n) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < n → ‖w‖ ≤ ρ → 0 ≤ K → IntegrableOn u (ball x (ρ + ‖w‖)) → (∀ z ∈ ball x (ρ + ‖w‖), |u z| ≤ K) → |(∫ y in ball (x + w) ρ, u y) - ∫ y in ball x ρ, u y| ≤ K * (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1)).toReal * ((ρ + ‖w‖) ^ n - (ρ - ‖w‖) ^ n)
